**Finding: MISSING — TRANSITION (post-termination transition assistance and data return)**

**What I checked**
- **Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment)** (p0023–p0029): covers only the one-year auto-renewing term, 90-day termination notice, and the Termination Payment formula/schedule. No exit obligations.
- **Section 1.4/1.5** (p0008–p0010): HDI's access and export-file obligations are term-limited operational duties, not a post-termination return right.
- **Section 8 (Confidentiality)** (p0047–p0054): protects our Content, user information and data but imposes no return or deletion duty on termination.
- **Section 10.7 (Survival)** (p0068): survives Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 only — no exit mechanics preserved.

**Why it fails the fallback**
This is a hosting agreement in which HDI holds the Site, our Content and user/customer data on HDI's server. With no export, return or migration obligation, termination leaves our data stranded on HDI's systems with no path to a successor host — short of even the fallback (90 days assistance plus 30-day export) and adjacent to walk-away territory (no data return).

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — new Section 4.3 inserted after p0029, at the preferred position: (a) up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, including migration cooperation; (b) return of all Content, user information and customer data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days of request; (c) certified deletion thereafter. The comment flags 90 days of assistance as an available fallback if HDI pushes back.
